# PlatusForge — open-source developer foundations

> PlatusForge is an open-source forge of production-grade developer foundations. Every solution is public, MIT-licensed and designed to be forked. Baseware — solution 01 — is a production-ready SaaS starter (Express 5 + strict TypeScript + Prisma 7 + PostgreSQL 16 backend; React 19 + Vite 8 frontend). More solutions are being forged in public.

- Site: https://platusforge.github.io/lp/
- Platform: PlatusForge — open-source foundations for developers
- Solution 01: Baseware — open-source SaaS starter
- More solutions: https://github.com/platusforge
- License: MIT — https://github.com/platusforge/baseware/blob/main/LICENSE.md
- Repository: https://github.com/platusforge/baseware
- Quickstart: `git clone https://github.com/platusforge/baseware.git` → `cd baseware && cp .env.example .env` → `docker compose up --build`
- Docs (EN): https://github.com/platusforge/baseware/tree/main/docs/en

## Solutions

- 01 — Baseware: open-source, production-ready SaaS starter. Live.
- Next foundations: shaped in public. Follow https://github.com/platusforge to see them land.

## What's included in Baseware

- Auth: email/password + Google/GitHub OAuth, TOTP MFA with hashed backup codes, 15-min access + rotating 7-day refresh in HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookies, bcrypt cost 12, lockout, rate limits, SHA-256 single-use 1h password-reset tokens, email verification, session listing/revocation
- B2B: organizations, members, invites, RBAC, per-organization Stripe subscriptions
- Billing: Stripe Checkout + Customer Portal + verified idempotent webhooks with dunning + audit log
- Platform: admin panel, audit logs, API keys, usage events, Resend transactional email
- Frontend: landing, pricing table, FAQ, file-based blog, OG/SEO meta, PT-BR + EN i18n
- Infra: Docker Compose (base/override/prod), multi-stage Dockerfiles, Nginx SPA + `/api` proxy, Traefik TLS, GitHub Actions push-to-deploy
- Quality: Jest unit tests, security audit gate, bilingual docs, AGENTS.md (mandatory build manual for AI coding agents)
- Architecture: strict 5-layer chain `Route → Controller → Service → Repository (interface) → Implementation`, manual DI, kebab-case filenames, Conventional Commits
- No license keys, seat limits or per-project tiers

## Stack

Express 5 · TypeScript strict · Prisma 7 · PostgreSQL 16 · Zod 4 · Winston · Stripe · Resend · React 19 · Vite 8 · React Router 7 · Docker · Traefik · GitHub Actions · Jest · Node 24
